newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar closes firmer in thin market.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar closes firmer in thin market.

text.p: LIFFE sugar firmed in low volume on Monday to double gains made during a lustreless day towards the close, traders said.
But they said the market lacked the underlying strength to give it momentum.
At the close most active May was up $1.60 at $309.90 on a volume of 698 lots.
The August contract gained $1.10 to $308.10 on a thin turnover of 111 lots.
"Technically it looks reasonably steady," one trader said. "But there's no fundamental reason for it to go any higher."

In fundamental news, a revised forecast for carryover non-quota "C" sugar into the 1997/98 marketing season was due to be discussed for the first time by the European Union's (EU) sugar management committee on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
